content: Ideal 2026 best practice for JWT SPAs is access token in-memory + refresh token in an HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite cookie (or full BFF token-vault) per OAuth SBCP (RFC 9700). This requires the backend to set/read that cookie. wheelio-api's /auth/login,/auth/refresh currently return both access AND refresh tokens as JSON body fields (confirmed in internal/adapter/httpapi/auth_handler.go) with no Set-Cookie -- and backend changes are out of scope for this milestone. Given that constraint, the frontend must fall back to a pragmatic pattern: access token in-memory only (module/store, never persisted), refresh token in localStorage (only option for persistence across reloads given the API contract), mitigated by short refresh-token TTL/rotation, strict CSP, and no third-party scripts.
